description: Spring Modulith Moments implements the Passage of Time Events pattern, publishing HourHasPassed, DayHasPassed, WeekHasPassed, MonthHasPassed, QuarterHasPassed, and YearHasPassed application events as time elapses. It auto-configures a Moments bean, or a time-shiftable TimeMachine bean for testing, so Spring Boot applications can trigger and test periodic business logic decoupled from the underlying scheduling mechanism.
